inline_label_follow_up.defect: Splitting inline-code spans before matching links separated the label of [`file`](path) from its destination.
inline_label_follow_up.negative_control: Before repair, the new test_code_in_link_label_still_routes_complete_link test rejected all four valid label variants.
inline_label_follow_up.repair: Use CommonMark inline block maps so rewriting cannot cross paragraph or heading boundaries. Fenced code, indented code, and HTML blocks remain byte-for-byte unchanged; inline HTML is shielded. Within each prose range, match links and code spans in source order: the full link starts before code in its label, while an outer code span starts before link-shaped examples in it.
new_controls: square brackets and embedded backticks in code labels
outer multi-backtick code spans containing link examples
unmatched backtick cannot cross paragraph or heading boundary
indented and tab-indented code remain unchanged
HTML block and inline attribute examples remain unchanged
indented prose continuation and list prose still route
publication-only Linux interpreter override/default and invalid-path rejection

review_findings.finding: Earlier bespoke scanner treated unmatched backticks across blank paragraphs as one code span.
review_findings.resolution: CommonMark inline block maps limit the source ranges; explicit regression passes.

dependency_setup.scope: Only the publication Linux check uses this ignored repository-local venv; no global or user install.
dependency_setup.explanation: Linux ensurepip is absent. The venv is created without pip and host pip installs only the two locked pure-Python wheels into its site-packages. The Python-version directory must match the selected Linux interpreter on another host.
dependency_setup.default: Existing WSL python3, or current interpreter on Linux, must have the locked parser dependencies. Missing dependencies fail rather than skip the guards. Other Linux lab runners are unchanged.
